item.title: MacPass 0.8.3.1
item.description:
Changes since upstream MacPass at c5ac6448:

  • Add scripts/run.sh to build and run MacPass without Xcode
  • Add optional sound when global Autotype finds no match
  • Fix Auto-Type matching for truncated browser window titles
  • Match Auto-Type against the URL of the page in the target window
  • Describe the fork in the README
  • Add scripts/release.sh for signed releases of the fork
  • Sign Sparkle updates with a key made on a1
  • Read the release keys from files, not from the keychain
  • Notarize with the notarytool-password profile that VoiceHotKey uses
  • Build the frameworks with xcodebuild and number releases 0.8.3.N
